A/B testing.resource: A/B Testing by Google (free course, Udacity)
A/B testing.miniProject: Analyze a public A/B test dataset: compute lift, a confidence interval and a ship/no-ship recommendation with one guardrail metric.
A/B testing.criterion: A one-page memo with sample size check, p-value/CI and a clear decision.

Statistics.miniProject: Run a regression on a public dataset and explain coefficients and their uncertainty to a non-technical reader.

dbt.miniProject: Build 3 dbt models (staging → mart) with tests on a sample dataset.
dbt.criterion: dbt build passes with at least 4 tests.

Data modeling.resource: dbt docs: How we structure our projects
Data modeling.miniProject: Design a star schema (1 fact, 3 dimensions) for an e-commerce dataset.
Data modeling.criterion: Diagram + SQL that answers 3 business questions.

Product analytics.miniProject: Build a signup → activation → retention funnel with weekly cohorts.
Product analytics.criterion: Cohort chart + 3 insights with a recommended action.

Python.miniProject: Rewrite one recurring Excel report as a pandas script.
Python.criterion: Script reproduces the report numbers exactly.

SQL.miniProject: Solve 10 window-function questions on a public dataset.

Tableau.miniProject: Build a 1-page KPI dashboard with filters.
Tableau.criterion: A stakeholder can answer 3 questions alone.

Looker.miniProject: Model one explore in LookML with 2 measures.

Power BI.miniProject: Build a Power BI report with one DAX measure.

Stakeholder communication.miniProject: Turn one past analysis into a 3-slide story: question, insight, decision.
Stakeholder communication.criterion: A colleague restates the decision in one sentence.

Forecasting.miniProject: Forecast 12 weeks of a public time series with a baseline and one better model.
Forecasting.criterion: Model beats the naive baseline on a holdout.

Excel.miniProject: Build a driver-based forecast model in Excel.
Excel.criterion: Inputs and outputs are clearly separated.

Snowflake.miniProject: Load a CSV and build one view in a trial warehouse.

Airflow.miniProject: Schedule a daily DAG that refreshes one table.

samples.label: Data Analyst · 4 yrs · New York
samples.cv:
Maya R. — Data Analyst, New York, NY. 4 years of experience.
Current: Data Analyst at a retail marketplace (2022–present). Write SQL queries in PostgreSQL to analyze orders and customer behavior. Built Tableau dashboards used weekly by the merchandising team. Automated monthly reporting with Python (pandas), saving 6 hours per month. Presented findings to stakeholders in leadership reviews.
Previous: Junior Analyst at a logistics company (2020–2022). Advanced Excel modeling with pivot tables. Tracked funnel and retention metrics for the customer app.
Education: BA Economics.
